result_text:
I changed the standard scoping conventions so only version-control metadata is ignored, IDE and build-tool folders are classified as build-and-deployment, and `dependencies` folders are no longer ignored. The full `codeanalyzer` test suite passes (334 tests, 0 failures, 3 skipped that were already skipped).

Changes in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`:

- **Ignore rules:** The `Hidden files and folders` rule is replaced by `(.*/)?[.](git|svn|hg|bzr)/.*` with the note "Version control metadata". The `(.*/)?` prefix lets a path that starts directly with `.git/` match.
- **Build and deployment:** Added `(.*/)?[.](idea|vscode|vs|gradle|mvn|settings|metadata|circleci)/.*` with the note "IDE and build tool files", at the end of the existing build-and-deployment list.
- **Dependencies:** Removed the `.*/dependencies/.*` ignore rule.

The `.yarn/releases`, `.yarn/plugins`, `node_modules` and `vendor` rules are untouched.

I also added `codeanalyzer/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventionsTest.java`. It checks that VCS folders are ignored, that dotfiles and `src/.config/Foo.java` are not, that IDE and build-tool folders are build-and-deployment, and that `dependencies/` is not ignored.

Nothing is committed.
